segments.text: Support desk, Marco speaking. — Our invoice went up and nobody told us why. — Let me look. You added two seats on the 3rd, so the plan was prorated for the rest of the month. — Nobody warned us about that. — I am sorry, I understand. I can send the breakdown to [EMAIL] so you can check it line by line. — Fine, send it.
